scope: Exact CMake generation/source effects in supported fresh OUT_DIR build. Generated outputs excluded from immutable external namespace. Current cache/log observations are not historical proof.

generation_dispositions.sundials: SundialsSetupConfig sets JOB_ID/JOB_START_TIME from CI_JOB_ID/CI_JOB_STARTED_AT or TIMESTAMP, and sundials_config.in substitutes both SUN_JOB_* macros. Bindgen exports them as public Rust string constants; current observed constants are20261006090450. Native Adiak consumption is feature-disabled, but generated public bindings still depend on clock. Final supported branch requires documented fixed SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH plus TZ, or explicit bound CI_JOB_ID/CI_JOB_STARTED_AT values. No ambient-clock source completeness grant.
generation_dispositions.highs: Compilation-date TIMESTAMP commented out. find_program(GIT) metadata discovery is reached; status/describe guarded by source .git presence. HIPO OFF excludes its FetchContent/OpenBLAS/Python paths. Linux ldd --version result used for CPack package filename, not compiled science library. ldd executable/script and PATH candidates nevertheless bound. HIGHS_MAJOR/MINOR/PATCH overrides affect compiled version macros; bind absence or exact values. HIGHS_VCPKG=OFF short-circuits vcpkg module.
generation_dispositions.cmake_git: Sundials FindGit version discovery reached; describe only if call-site source .git exists. Bind package source .git absence and actual Git executable/version lookup.
generation_dispositions.generated_output: Four recorded include roots under selected highs/sundials OUT_DIR are generated output, not immutable external input. Fresh selected build owner OUT_DIR has no starting CMakeCache authority; future reuse binds deterministic source/tools and captured generated artifacts.

clock_probe.scope: Standalone CMake3.28 script only; no native build or Cargo. Explicit SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=0, two repeats for each TZ; zero failure baseline.
